steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Cue. Titecuani! She... she's something.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Whaddaya know, you guys are pretty strong! Shame you had to run into me, Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Wait... wait, what did you say your name was?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ga-vi-al!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: Gavial?!

steps.name: Archosauria B
steps.text: Wait! Look close! That face, that hair! You're Gavial, aren't you?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I feel like I just said I was!

steps.name: Archosauria A
steps.text: It-It's Gavial! Gavial's back! Brothers! Go, hurry! Tell Clan Leader Eunectes!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What? Eunectes? Hey! Get back here!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Tch. Ran off.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Thank goodness! If you'd been just a little later, they would've taken me.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Where's our pilot guy? Uh, his name, uh, Dylan! Where's Dylan?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: He tried to fight some of the Archosauria in the middle of it all. They knocked him out.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh! Gavial, I found Dylan here!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Good. Drag him over. I'll take a look at the damage.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Say, Lancet-2, you can fix this aircraft, right?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Yes! Closure input lots of aircraft knowledge into me before we left.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: In principle, following a successful emergency landing, the tools provided should be sufficient for a repair.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Only...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Kay, I asked you to drag him over, not to LITERALLY drag him over.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Oh. Sorry.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Looks like they didn't get any kills on us, huh? Wow, who knew this guy's underwear would be so gaudy... heh. Yeah, let him have his beauty sleep and he'll wake himself up.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Lancet-2, you were saying? Only what?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Only, the Archosauria we just met stole the engine.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah? The engine?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Correct. Before they noticed me, I sighted them from the deck. They found the aircraft's engine, pulled it out, and carried it away with them.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Come see for yourself.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hoo, boy. Yeah, that's a hole. I don't really get how these things actually work, but, uh, I'm guessing this means it won't fly now?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Yes, it won't fly now.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh? Doctor, you don't look too good.

options: None of this looks too good.

steps.text: A short while back

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: A letter?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. From my homeland. They're holding the Mahuizzotia again soon.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: 'Mahuizzotia.' Strength and honor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh, you know it? Yeah, it's what they call the ceremony where they choose the next Great Chief.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I haven't heard anyone use that language in a long time.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: As I recall, though, you left your homeland and then came to Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, but there’s this li’l kid I knew who still keeps in touch with me. She’s the one who sent the letter.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: I also recall you saying that you left because you were ostracized. If so, the election of the chief shouldn't concern you at all.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah... hell, no, I'm not going out to be the next Great Chieftain. Just, the brat seems like she really wants me to come back for a bit, and I haven't been back in a bit, and...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Homesickness?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Maybe a little, yeah.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And why are you requesting to bring Dr. {@nickname}? From a biological standpoint, the Doctor couldn't pass for one of you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: The Doctor's been working so hard, y'know? I figured it'd be a nice little vacation.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And what was the purpose of this aircraft requisition form, Blaze?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Gavial's old place is way out in the middle of nowhere Sargon! Who'd walk that far?

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: So instead of walking, you want to use a low-altitude aircraft and risk detection by the Sargon authorities.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Wait, lemme explain! When I say nowhere, I mean we looked at the maps and Gavial's is one of the lest densely populated regions of Sargon. From the intel we've gathered, Sargon doesn't even station any forces there.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: You're correct that the region is Sargon's in name only. You've done your homework.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And now, seeing as you've made all your plans, why have you come to me?

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: B-Because any and all paperwork passes through you...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Are we good or not, Kal'tsit? If not, we'll forget it and move on.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: (Quietly) Doctor, maybe we should just call it off. There's no way Kal'tsit's gonna agree...

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Fine. I've approved it.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: Seriously?!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Gavial, you've never properly introduced us to your hometown before.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: And considering your standing as a core member of Rhodes Island, and the initiative you showed in making this proposal, we can afford to grant Dr. {@nickname} this leave, given accompaniment by an elite operator.

steps.name: Blaze
steps.text: That's what I like to hear!

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Further, I will treat this operation as an on-site field investigation. You may freely select any off-duty operators.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Amiya has been very busy as of late. She is not allowed to go, whether she wants to or not. You will have to tell her this yourself.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Keep in mind that you are technically entering Sargon territory. Rhodes Island has very few offices in Sargon. Don't make trouble for yourselves, or for Rhodes Island.

steps.name: Kal'tsit
steps.text: Further, Rhodes Island's low-altitude aircraft are tremendously important to us, and Sargon is a rough environment. I trust you to bring the vehicle back safe and sound, Dr. {@nickname}.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Ohhh. Now that you mention it, yeah, that sounds about right.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, relax, Doctor! This is my homeland. I know it like the back of my hand. Lancet-2, we've just gotta find the kiddos who stole the engine and steal it right back, yeah?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Yes... They definitely seemed to have some understanding of technology, at least. They hardly damaged anything else in the removal process.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: In the event we do get the engine back, I should be able to guide you through reinstallation.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: On that note, there's some emergency maintenance I must carry out before any of this ends up exploding. Please hold...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Them? Technology? First I've heard of any of us getting along with technology. We're all knuckleheads by nature.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Specifically, only enough to know how to pull out the pipes and cables, but...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...Wait, hold on. I bet if they're her minions...

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Gavial, I'm hungry!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: All our food reserves should be fine, right?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: They should be fine, yes.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: But some systems were damaged by the emergency landing. The storage compartment is currently sealed. I'll need some time to unlock it again...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hang in there a little longer, then, Kay.

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: But I'm hungry nowww!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Fine, then. Let's go and...
Gaaaaviiiiaaaaal!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Oh, crud. I know that voice.
Wow, Gavial! You're actually here!
Gavial, your hair's gotten long!
Gavial, your clothes look really good!
Gavial, you have a weapon now! How come? It doesn't look very good for hitting people!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Gurgh! Yes, Tomimi, it's me, you're not imagining it. Just let go of me first!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Okay!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, have you been eating okay out there?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Did you really become a doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: ...*Sigh* What are you doing here, Tomimi?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So I saw a thing fall out of the sky, and I went to see what it was, and then I saw you!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, is your disease thing better yet? I read that people outside can get Stone Disease really bad. Are you okay?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I'm fine, I'm fine. Never better.

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Gavial! You're really back!

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: It's good to see you alive and well after all, Gavial!

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: No mistake, you need to be our next Great Chief!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Dream on. I'm only on leave. Came back to see how things are going.

options: Gavial, didn't you say you were ostracized from your tribe?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah. Why?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, who-who is this person?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Tomimi, you can speak standard Sargonian now? Pretty fluently too.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yep! I learned it just so I could speak with you, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Not bad. I guess I'll write to you in Sargonian from now on, then.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...So, um, Gavial, who are all these people?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, this one's Dr. {@nickname}. Doctor, for short. Counts as my boss, I guess?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: And then the rest are all friends from work.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial's boss... are you actually stronger than her?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: So how'd you get to be Gavial's boss, then?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Gavial, this one looks pretty weak to me.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: No way!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: I've got bigger problems, Tomimi. Zumama's people stole our aircraft engine after the crash. She's got minions now?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: What's an aircraft engine? Is it like one of those motory things? Wait, um... huh? Zumama?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What about her?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Ah, um, Zumama's the chief of a tribe now. There's a lot of people who think she'll be the next Great Chief, too.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Aah... So that's how it is. Could've been her crew that took us down, too. She's the only one who was into those weird wacky gizmo weapons in the first place.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: ...Yeah, yeah! If you wanna find Zumama, the ceremony's starting tomorrow, and every aspiring Chief is gonna be at the Temple. Zumama'll be there for sure.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: So all we gotta do to find her is head there, huh? Ha! Perfect.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hey, didn't you say your cute little noggin wanted to compete for it too? Go on, show me how far you've come in all these years!

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: (Quietly) I still want you to be the Chief, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Huh? Whawazzat?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: N-Nothing!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Doctor, emergency maintenance has been completed. Are we setting off now?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Nice work, Lancet-2. Yeah, we're heading to the Temple next.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Wowww! The machine talks!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I like to think I'm ready for it, but it still hurts my heart a little whenever I get that sort of reaction. Not that I technically have a heart...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Aircraft won't explode now, right?

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: It won't, but it's not exactly ideal to just leave it here...

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Yeah, true. I don't want Kal'tsit giving me the death stare either.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: I-If I send, um, some of my people out to take it back to my tribe, would that help?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Your tribe? Huh? Hell, I didn't realize. So our little girl's a full-grown clan leader now, huh?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Yes! It actually used to be your tribe, Gavial.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Well, damn. No wonder I recognized a couple of faces...

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Oh, also! Gavial, we changed the tribe's name now! 'Wilderness's Will' is now 'Gavial's Will'!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hah?

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Because we all think you're the best, Gavial!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh—*cough* *cough*—okay, whatever. I'll leave you to it.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: Did everyone get that?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: Yeah!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Ah, in that case, I think Mr. Dylan and I will stay with the aircraft.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: I understand you're going to meet a large number of people. I would only cause problems if I went.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: And the aircraft does need guarding.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What? You're not gonna go see the ceremony? It's a hell of a treat.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Don't worry about it. I prefer the quieter side of things, anyway.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Suit yourself. I guess it'll be just me, the Doctor, and, uh, Kay going, then.

steps.name: Tomimi
steps.text: And me! And I'll bring some of my people with us too!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Please wait a moment, Doctor. What about Kay?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: What's up, Doctor?

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Hm? Wait up. Where'd Kay go?!

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, huh. You're right, she was just here. Where'd that little rascal run off to?

steps.name: Archosauria
steps.text: When you say Kay, do you mean the one jabbering away over there like she's half-possessed?

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: I'm not gonna let you hurt the Doctor, Reunion!

steps.name: Ceobe
steps.text: Nooo! Don't steal my honey biscuits! Get back here!

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Kay appears to be fighting the air... Um, this could be a case of poison-induced hallucination.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh! Shit! I forgot to warn you! There's a hell of a lot of mushrooms and fruits growing wild along the road here, and more than most of them you can't eat. If you do, you end up like that.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Forgot the kid was even wilder than me. I bet she snuck off while we were busy talking and helped herself to the buffet.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Uh, damn it. Okay. Go tie her up and take her back with you, Lancet-2. She'll be fine after a while, probably.

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Leave it to me~

steps.name: Lancet-2
steps.text: Oh, one last friendly reminder. Our surroundings are quite hot, but such environments are prone to drastic nighttime temperature swings. Please bring the necessary supplies with you.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: Oh, nice catch. Doctor, Tomimi, you two make sure you grab what you need from the aircraft.

steps.name: Gavial
steps.text: It's a long way to the Temple from here, and the rainforest won't have anywhere decent to sleep. Get ready to spend the night in the open.
